title: Tensor and ordinary Hom comparison data for exact reindexing
statement: theorem podReindexing_tensor_hom_data {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [EssentiallySmall.{u+1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u+1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ) : ∃ σ : ∀ M N : podReindexingModules l E Y s, (podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj (podReindexingTensor l E Y s M N) ≅ podReindexingTensor l E X s ((podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj M) ((podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj N), ∃ η : ∀ M N : podReindexingModules l E Y s, (podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (J := ProEt.topology Y) (R := podReindexingRing l E Y s) M N) ≅ SheafOfModules.homObj (J := ProEt.topology X) (R := podReindexingRing l E X s) ((podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj M) ((podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj N), (∀ (M N : podReindexingModules l E Y s) (U : X.ProEt) (a : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))) (b : N.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))), (σ M N).hom.val.app (op U) (purTensorSection (podReindexingRing l E Y s) M N ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U) a b) = purTensorSection (podReindexingRing l E X s) ((podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj M) ((podReindexingFunctor l E g s).obj N) U a b) ∧ (∀ (M N : podReindexingModules l E Y s) (U V : X.ProEt) (a : V ⟶ U) (f : (SheafOfModules.homObj (J := ProEt.topology Y) (R := podReindexingRing l E Y s) M N).val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))) (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj V))), ((η M N).hom.val.app (op U) f).app (op (Over.mk a)) x = f.app (op (Over.mk ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).map a))) x)
